# Documentation screenshots

The eight current README images were captured on 22 October 2026 with Kō 1.3.0 and approved by the project owner before inclusion.

Reference: [日本語 — owner-provided Google Doc](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1ckvrIRrRtpgJKCsPf81XomxGdU3k0JFUMUEt90pyI8k/edit?usp=sharing).

The captures use an isolated browser profile and the live, read-only document. The source document was not edited. All eight PNGs are 1440 × 1000 pixels; the approved image files are included without cropping or rescaling.

| Image | Feature |
| --- | --- |
| [google-docs-furigana-1.3.png](google-docs-furigana-1.3.png) | Automatic furigana over the original document text. |
| [google-docs-reading-view-1.3.png](google-docs-reading-view-1.3.png) | Extra-space Reading view alongside the source document. |
| [google-docs-dictionary-1.3.png](google-docs-dictionary-1.3.png) | English and Japanese definitions for 平和 from the bundled dictionaries. |
| [google-docs-verb-forms-1.3.png](google-docs-verb-forms-1.3.png) | 受け取れ as the Direct command form of 受け取る. |
| [google-docs-adjective-forms-1.3.png](google-docs-adjective-forms-1.3.png) | 高い → 高くなかった, entered separately in Playgrounds. |
| [google-docs-mimetics-1.3.png](google-docs-mimetics-1.3.png) | The ぱくぱく／もぐもぐ illustrated comparison in Playgrounds. |
| [ko-kun-kaizokuou-1.3.png](ko-kun-kaizokuou-1.3.png) | Kōくん looking up 海賊王 (かいぞくおう, pirate king) from Reading view using offline JMdict. |
| [ko-kun-samurai-1.3.png](ko-kun-samurai-1.3.png) | A frame from Kōくん’s existing samurai routine beside the document. |

For the samurai capture, a temporary copy of the extension selected the existing samurai routine directly so a clear sword pose could be captured. Project source, shipped animation assets, and normal scheduling were not changed.

Older screenshots remain here as historical captures. The images under `../store-assets/screenshots/` are separate store artwork; adding these documentation images does not update the Chrome Web Store listing.
